note: Feature requirements extracted from the Atom.IO GDD. Regenerate with `python main.py build --extract-requirements`, then review the diff. 'evidence' is what the scanner looks for in the Unity scripts; it is also the contract the code writer must satisfy.

requirements.title: Virtual-joystick movement
requirements.description: The player moves the atom with a virtual joystick on the left of the screen.
acceptance: Left on-screen stick moves the player
Movement is clamped to the arena

requirements.title: Bohr-model orbiting electrons
requirements.description: Electrons orbit the core in Bohr shells (2 then 8); slots equal the atomic number.
acceptance: Every run and level starts with 1 electron; no minimum after that

requirements.title: Aim and throw spare electrons
requirements.description: The right stick aims (drag vector on the newest electron); releasing throws it; any electron can be thrown, even the last one.
acceptance: The last electron can be thrown too (the player is then defenceless)

requirements.title: Health and contact damage
requirements.description: HP = 10 x protons; enemies touching the core deal 10 damage; the run ends at 0 HP.

requirements.title: Enemies that chase and give up
requirements.description: Enemies spawn far away, chase the player within sight range and give up when the player escapes; electrons damage them (10 orbit / 20 thrown).

requirements.title: Time-scaled spawning
requirements.description: Enemies, energy orbs and wild electrons spawn randomly; intervals shrink with time in the arena.

requirements.title: Energy orbs
requirements.description: Energy orbs spawn naturally and drop from killed enemies; touching one collects its energy.

requirements.title: Energy-bar evolution
requirements.description: Collected energy fills a bar of capacity 50 + 3Z + 5(Z-1)^2 (later levels need more); when full the player evolves mid-run into the next element and level, and the bar empties to 0. Progress persists between runs.
acceptance: Evolve on the spot when full

requirements.title: One designed level per element
requirements.description: Each element H..Ne loads its own level config (theme, obstacles, spawn pressure, core look, trait).

requirements.title: Win at Neon
requirements.description: Reaching Neon (Z=10) completes the game; Neon's arena stays playable.

requirements.title: Top-left HUD
requirements.description: Top-left player info: current element, health bar, energy bar toward the next element, time survived.
acceptance: Element, HP bar, energy bar and time shown

requirements.title: Two-stage tutorial
requirements.description: First run as H teaches orbit damage and orbs; the first time the player becomes He it teaches throwing and picking up electrons.

requirements.title: Lobby
requirements.description: The lobby shows the current element and energy bar and starts a run.

requirements.title: Exit arena button
requirements.description: A top-right exit button ends the run and returns to the lobby.
acceptance: Exit returns to the lobby, bar progress kept

requirements.title: Arena settings menu
requirements.description: A top-right settings button in the arena opens a small menu that pauses the game, with Resume, sound on/off and Exit to lobby.
acceptance: Top-right settings button in the arena

requirements.title: Element-group abilities
requirements.description: Each element group (6 groups from H to Ne) has an ability, loaded from the generated group_abilities.json, that triggers in the arena (passive, on_low_hp, on_kill, on_pickup, on_orbit_hit, on_release) with its effect, value and cooldown. The active ability switches when the player evolves into a new group.
acceptance: Active ability follows the current level's group and switches on evolution
Triggers and cooldowns work as described in the JSON
Never makes the player permanently immune

requirements.title: Element card in the lobby
requirements.description: The lobby shows the current element's card (title and flavor from the generated element_cards.json) and which element comes next, so the next evolution is always in sight.
acceptance: Shows title + flavor for the current element
Shows the next element (or 'complete' at Neon)

requirements.title: Ability indicator in the HUD
requirements.description: A small HUD label shows the active group ability's name and when it is ready again (cooldown).
